defaults.backend: complete: clean-room conversation operations over NOVARA's support tickets with agent presence, temporary snoozes with due-sweep, @mentions in internal notes through the local event spine, polling collision detection with typing indicators and idempotent replies, per-message read receipts, bulk status/assignee/label actions, saved folders with live counts, per-user mutes, and timezone-aware weekly/override/holiday/split-shift business hours with local away messages
defaults.frontend: complete: dedicated conversation-ops Operations route renders presence, snoozes, mentions, collision/receipts, bulk actions, folders, mutes and inbox hours with create/edit/evaluate forms; static guard in test_ui_wiring.py
defaults.database: complete: twelve additive workspace-scoped tables created by migration c8d0e1f2a3b4 (agent_presence, conversation_snoozes, note_mentions, typing_indicators, message_receipts, conversation_mutes, conversation_folders, inbox_hours, hours_slots, hours_overrides, inbox_holidays, reply_dedup), with dedupe constraints on all per-user/per-record relations; existing support tables untouched

defaults.criteria: Fifteen named acceptance tests plus a workspace-isolation test prove presence, snooze/requeue, local mentions, collision warnings and deduped replies, read receipts, bulk actions, live folder counts, mutes, timezone-aware schedules/overrides/holidays/split shifts, away messages and a wired UI route.
defaults.remaining: No remaining work for the recorded local acceptance criteria. WebSocket transport, widget SDKs, help centres, hosted APIs, outbound notifications, MFA and IANA DST rules in the fixed-offset fallback remain out of scope and are not claimed.
